title: Tru Tien Episode 1: The Sealed Flame
audience: Fans of Chinese fantasy, cultivation/xianxia drama viewers, 18-35 demographic who enjoy underdog transformation and flame-rebirth stories
tone: Sorrowful, gritty, defiant, epic, emotionally charged

concept.hook: They stole his fire. Burned his future. But fire — true fire — cannot be destroyed. Only hidden.
concept.story_arc: Valley of ashes — The humiliation — The shattered spirit sea — Mysterious presence stirs — The first spark
concept.emotion: Anguish — Shame — Numbness — Awakening — Defiant hope

shots.prompt: Extreme wide shot — a young man collapses alone in a scorched volcanic valley. Grey ash covers everything. Dead trees twisted like claws reach from black rock. His plain grey training robes are burned and torn. His entire back is marked with angry red sealing scars — a spiritual seal carved into his flesh and meridians. He drags himself forward through ash on his elbows, leaving a trail. His face is gaunt, hollow, eyes vacant. In his clenched fist he holds a single charred wooden practice sword. Camera: extreme wide establishing shot, slow push in to medium shot as he crawls forward. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Push in — extreme wide to medium, 6s
shots.narration: Once, his fire could melt mountains. They sealed it with a forbidden technique — carved into his flesh while he screamed. Left him in the Valley of Ashes to die.
shots.sfx: Burning embers crackling, ash wind, distant volcanic rumble, ragged breathing, cloth dragging on stone

shots.prompt: Close-up — a flashback vision: a beautiful woman in white robes stands before him in a great hall filled with elders. She raises her hand, and violet sealing light erupts from her palm, striking his chest. His eyes go wide with betrayal — she was his teacher, his mentor, the one he trusted most. Then the memory cuts. Present: he lies in ash, his fist clenching the charred practice sword so hard his knuckles bleed. Tears cut tracks through the ash on his face. He exhales — and a wisp of grey smoke escapes his lips — his fire, dying. Camera: flashback close-up of betrayal, then cut to present close-up on bleeding fist and dying smoke. 6 seconds.
shots.narration: Her hand raised in blessing — and she carved the seal into his back. Even as he fell, he remembered her cold words: You were always too arrogant for your own good.
shots.sfx: Spiritual seal zap crackling, elders murmuring, single tear hitting ash, breath exhale with dying ember

shots.prompt: Medium wide shot — he finally stops moving. He lies on his back in the ash, staring upward at a grey sky through the twisted dead trees. His hand moves to his chest — the center of his dantian. Where a blazing fire spirit sea once roared, there is only silence and cold — a shattered spirit sea, dark and cracked. He presses his palm flat against his chest. Nothing. No warmth. No power. Not even pain. Just emptiness. A broken cultivator. Camera: medium wide shot overhead, his body in ash, slow pan down from sky to his hand pressing chest. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Pan down — overhead ash valley to hand on chest, 6s
shots.narration: In his chest — where a fire spirit sea once blazed — there was nothing. Just cold silence and the memory of what once burned there.
shots.sfx: Wind howling through dead valley, heartbeat slow and hollow, ash settling, silence except for breath

shots.prompt: Close-up — in the darkness of his shattered spirit sea, something stirs. A faint point of deep crimson light pulses at the very deepest core — ancient, patient, sleeping. It pulses in response to his despair. His eyes snap open. He feels it — something still alive inside him. He presses harder on his chest, breathing fast now. The crimson point flickers brighter. Ancient glyphs briefly appear in the air around him, glowing deep red, then fade. Camera: extreme close-up on his eye widening, then a stylized vision of the crimson point pulsing in the dark spirit sea, then back to his face. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up eye + spirit sea vision, 6s
shots.narration: But deep in the abyss of his shattered spirit sea — something ancient had not forgotten. A flame that had burned since before the world was born. And it had been waiting.
shots.sfx: Deep bass hum from within, glyph resonance chime, heartbeat suddenly intensifying, wind dropping to near silence

shots.prompt: Medium shot — he rises to his knees. He throws his head back and screams into the grey sky — raw, anguished, defiant. His voice echoes through the dead valley. The ash swirls violently around him. A single ember — crimson red — appears in his raised palm, glowing against the darkness. The first spark of the fire that will be reborn. His scream becomes a controlled exhale. He stares at the ember with cold, burning eyes. His teacher took his fire from his meridians — but she did not know what slept in the deepest core. Camera: medium shot, slow push in from screaming to the burning ember in his palm, ending on his cold, determined eyes. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Push in — screaming mid to ember in palm, ending on eyes, 6s
shots.narration: They sealed his fire in his flesh. But they made one mistake — the fire they sealed was not his true fire. And his true fire — was never theirs to take.
shots.sfx: Primal scream echoing through valley, ash swirl intensifying, ember crackling to life, bass surge, resolve-filled breath exhale

audio.narration: Once, his fire could melt mountains. They sealed it with a forbidden technique — carved into his flesh while he screamed. Left him in the Valley of Ashes to die. Her hand raised in blessing — and she carved the seal into his back. Even as he fell, he remembered her cold words: You were always too arrogant for your own good. In his chest — where a fire spirit sea once blazed — there was nothing. Just cold silence and the memory of what once burned there. But deep in the abyss of his shattered spirit sea — something ancient had not forgotten. A flame that had burned since before the world was born. And it had been waiting. They sealed his fire in his flesh. But they made one mistake — the fire they sealed was not his true fire. And his true fire — was never theirs to take.
audio.bg_music: Gritty epic xianxia soundtrack, low cello and deep strings, building percussion, mournful flute opening transitioning to intense determination, 78 BPM

deep bass hum from within and glyph chime
primal scream and ember crackling to life
